d:
The beauty of monsoon, the magic of love and the timeless voice of Lata Mangeshkar come together in Saawan Ke Jhoole Pade from the classic film Jurmana (1979). Featuring Rakhee, Amitabh Bachchan and Vinod Mehra, this melodious song captures the poetic charm of the rainy season and the romance of 70s Hindi cinema.
